title: Paper Accepted at ISCA 2026
description: Our paper on 'Energy-Efficient In-Memory Computing Architectures for Deep Learning Inference' has been accepted at the International Symposium on Computer Architecture (ISCA) 2026.

title: Best Paper Award at DATE 2025
description: Congratulations to our team for receiving the Best Paper Award at the Design, Automation and Test in Europe (DATE) 2025 conference.

title: New PhD Students Join the Lab
description: We welcome three new PhD students to the SARCS Lab this fall semester. Looking forward to exciting research collaborations!

title: Invited Talk at MIT
description: Prof. Smith delivered an invited talk on 'Future of RISC-V in Edge Computing' at MIT's Computer Science Colloquium.

title: NSF Grant Awarded
description: Our lab has been awarded a $1.2M NSF grant for research on 'Secure and Efficient Hardware Accelerators for Post-Quantum Cryptography'.

title: Summer Internship Program Concludes
description: Our summer internship program concluded with excellent presentations from 8 undergraduate researchers. Great work everyone!

title: Featured in IEEE Spectrum
description: Our research on neuromorphic computing was featured in IEEE Spectrum's article on 'The Future of Brain-Inspired Computing'.
